description:
Total the ADR 1.1.3.6 points for a road load of dangerous goods and say whether it stays within the small-load exemption, and what still applies if it does.
Use when: the user asks whether a vehicle load needs full ADR. Instead: un_number_packaging for container rules; bund_size for storage.
Inputs: one line per substance and package size, so the same UN number in two package sizes is two lines. packing_group matters only where a UN number has entries in more than one transport category, such as UN 1263 paint; without it those lines are refused with the entries to choose from. Points are quantity_per_package times packages times the category multiplier: 50 for category 1, 3 for category 2, 1 for category 3 and 0 for category 4. A category 0 substance needs full ADR at any quantity.
Behaviour: covers 92 UN numbers. If any line cannot be read, the whole load is refused with a reason per line and never totalled without it. An exempt load still carries duties, listed in still_required. Unknown arguments are ignored and named in assumed.
Constraints: no authentication, key or headers. At most 10 requests per 10 seconds per IP address; above that HTTP 429, so space out repeated calls.

packages.description: Number of packages of this size

packing_group.description: Packing group from section 14 of the safety data sheet. Required where the UN number has entries in more than one transport category, such as 1263 paint; the refusal lists them

quantity_per_package.description: Litres (liquids) or kg (solids) in each package, e.g. 20 for a 20 L jerrican

name: adr_1000_points

assumed.description: Each value the tool inferred or defaulted, in words, so it can be checked with the user

cite.description: Credit line with a link, for quoting the answer

error.description: When ok is false: what is missing or could not be read, and what to send instead

exempt.description: true when the load stays within ADR 1.1.3.6

issues.description: When ok is false: the reason for each unreadable line

lines.description: Each line with UN number, name, packing group, transport category, quantity, unit, multiplier and points

ok.description: true with an answer. false when the tool needs one more input or cannot answer; error then says what to send

publisher.description: Who publishes the tool, the Fortitude21 products that fit, with links, and quote_url, a link to ask for a quotation

room.description: Points or quantity left before the limit

test.description: Which test applies: points across categories, or the quantity limit of one category

tool.description: Link to the same answer on the interactive tool page

transport_category.description: The category that decides the limit

title: ADR 1.1.3.6 small-load points
